title: kiln.json
description: config is .kiln/kiln.json, read from main's tip, so a build cannot weaken the gate it is held to.

$schema.description: Schema names the JSON Schema an editor checks kiln.json against, ./kiln.schema.json, which kiln init writes. kiln reads nothing from it.

gate.description: Gate holds the commands the gate runs, each with sh -c, at the top of a worktree.

rounds.description: Rounds is how many times a failing gate goes back to the session before the build stops.

hosts.description: Hosts are the only hosts a session's commands reach.

writable.description: Writable holds commands, each run with sh -c. Each field one prints is a path a session's commands may write.

mcp.description: MCP holds the only MCP servers a session reaches, by name, each as Claude Code's mcpServers holds one. They run outside the sandbox.

gauges.description: Gauges are read after each landing, and never block one.

items.description: gauge is a command kiln.json names, or a monitor's gauge, which prints a number. Its line is where that number should stay.

name.description: Name names the gauge. No two gauges share one.

command.description: Command runs with sh -c, at the top of a worktree at the commit it reads. That is a landing, main's tip, or a fix's commit. Its last line of stdout is its reading.

min.description: Min is the line a reading below crosses.

max.description: Max is the line a reading above crosses.

workflow.description: Workflow is "split", or "" for build then audit. Like Acceptance and Harness, kiln reads it at the commit the build was queued at.

acceptance.description: Acceptance holds each path a spec's acceptance tests live in, with {spec} for its name, such as "acceptance/{spec}/". A JSON string is a list of one.

harness.description: Harness holds paths both sessions of a split build may write, such as the code the acceptance tests run through.

reaudit.description: Reaudit holds paths the audit reads again whenever the work's own change to them differs from what it read.

notify.description: Notify is the command that receives each notification, run with sh -c. "" prints each as OSC 9.

timeout.description: Timeout is how long a project's command may run, or a session print nothing, before kiln kills it. It is a Go duration above zero, such as "2h", or unset for kiln's default.
